ROUTE_IDENTITY.detail: The current family, local packet-set manifest, product wiring, field map, source receipt and guide all bind de_discretionary_family_court-set to obligation:track-only:DE:de_discretionary_family_court and 11 Del. C. § 4374(c). The legal memo leaves the latest amendment question open, recorded separately in legalGate; that does not make this file-to-route identity ambiguous.

The source-derived anchors are present in the current official pages; selected print bases rehash to the current saved-byte proof. The Form 281E converter-only repeated-header page is excluded.

COMPONENT_SET.detail: The current candidate physically renders the three locally declared components: required Form 281, conditional Form 281E when charges exceed four petition rows, and required custom assembly sheet; both fixtures and page manifests contain them. The controlling Family Court track still asks which proposed order the court expects, and no accepted order source or packet order has been resolved. The physically measured local set therefore cannot be promoted to the authoritative component set.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.detail: Current actual-writes has 21 canonical and 41 boundary writes, including supplied name/contact/P.O. box/email/interpreter/language, criminal case number and 2 versus 5 charge rows. Every declared write was independently checked for non-empty text readback on its current page; 62/62 passed.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: The participant blank report declares 11 required-before-filing items; every effective label occurs in the current participant guide. All seven controlling track participant questions also occur. The guide keeps certified-history acquisition, charge cross-check, Family Court disposition, venue, manifest-injustice facts, fines/fees/restitution, fee confirmation and notarization as participant work.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: The guide leaves county selection, the manifest-injustice assertion, Civil Petition No. and signature/jurat to the participant or court. The participant election report lists six election blanks; the supplied interpreter-needed Yes is the only corresponding participant fact written, while the No alternative remains unselected. No route-owned county or legal assertion was invented.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: The field map declares four primary rows and 23 continuation rows. Canonical writes two complete primary charge rows; boundary writes four complete primary rows plus one complete Form 281E continuation row. No partial populated row was found.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.detail: The current field map has 20 refusal rows; their field IDs have no intersection with actual writes, and both actual-writes documents report no refused field with ink. Civil Petition No., petitioner signature and sworn jurat remain blank; no court/attorney approval is synthesized.

ARTIFACTS.detail: The frozen current PDFs rehash exactly to the manifest and rendered-artifacts bindings: canonical 0fa7f874fd1cba94e6a5fb775b7feaa7f2f07d9e6aba62d5057bb7f4e0cae8d9 / 55926 bytes / 2 pages; boundary 1a7c70f9bd6e78bb56b5b7206d1078bf7a6a9c0c1688763e6e3ffe3235fd5479 / 87635 bytes / 3 pages.

PAGE_ORDER.detail: Canonical page order is Form 281 then custom assembly. Boundary order is Form 281, conditional Form 281E page 1, then custom assembly. The exact rendered-artifacts page manifests and current page counts agree.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.detail: No central raster or original page images were available in this review. The independent source-pixel check found no substantive added ink outside declared write boxes with a conservative 3-pixel edge guard, but that is source-preservation evidence and does not substitute for the central visual gate.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: The guide and filing instructions direct filing in Family Court for the county where the most recent case terminated, only when all sought charges/convictions were disposed of there; no county is selected by the builder.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The guide truthfully states that § 4374(j) lets each court set the fee, that whether Family Court adult petitions carry the same $75 fee is unresolved, inserts no fee amount, and describes the conditional § 4372(l) waiver/conversion. The controlling track retains this fee and packet-order question as a release blocker, so this obligation cannot pass the legal gate.

SERVICE.detail: The guide states petitioner service on the Attorney General, the 120-day objection/answer period, the 30-day response period after opposition, and clerk email after assignment of a case number.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The guide provides stop/self-help handoffs for AG or victim opposition, hearings or contested facts, pending charges, current supervision/incarceration, § 4373(b) victim categories, unclear venue, unpaid fines/fees/restitution and collateral consequences.

derivedFactLineage: The candidate writes only supplied participant identity/contact/interpreter facts and supplied charge rows; the criminal case number is a held matter fact.
The canonical fixture has two complete primary rows and no continuation; the boundary fixture has four complete primary rows and one overflow Form 281E row, exercising the declared conditional.

County, manifest-injustice assertion/explanation, certified-history proof, eligibility, Civil Petition No., signature/jurat, fee amount, court order and approval remain participant/court/legal-owned. The guide names each required handoff.
The custom assembly is an internal required preparation sheet; it does not claim to be a court form or an accepted Family Court proposed order.

independentByteProof.method: Independent SHA-256 and byte-length checks; Poppler page-size/count and page-text readback; exact source rehash; current write text readback; refusal/write intersection; component/page-manifest check; guide/required-question check; and 150dpi source-pixel preservation comparison using a conservative 3-pixel edge guard. No central raster/original PNG visual claim.
independentByteProof.sourcePixelPreservation: All three official source-page comparisons had zero substantive output-darkening pixels outside the declared write boxes with the 3px edge guard; the unguarded 2px run observed six canonical lower-edge antialias pixels, so this is not used as a clipping/visual pass.
